dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the maximum width at the mid-section toward a thin, elongated posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical indentation visible on the left lateral margin at the mid-posterior transition; right margin exhibits a smooth, continuous curve.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median reflectance across the dorsal plane with minimal grayscale variation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Series of transverse, low-contrast epidermal folds visible in the cervical region immediately posterior to the blowhole; elevated longitudinal ridge visible along the dorsal midline of the peduncle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark elliptical blowhole orifice centered on the anterior dorsal midline.
